description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for progressive expansion processing, such as expanding tree nodes in batches to avoid blocking the UI. It includes a non-React controller for batching work with fallback mechanisms and a React hook to manage its state within React components.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batching work items in slices, utilizing requestIdleCallback if available or setTimeout as fallback, and provides start and cancel methods along with progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps around createProgressiveExpandController to manage UI state (running/progress) and provides methods to start batch processing with React component lifecycle management.

ctags.name: createProgressiveExpandController
ctags.signature: ({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })

ctags.name: useProgressiveExpand
ctags.signature: ({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
